heading: Klipper configuration
description: Read and edit this machine’s .cfg files through Moonraker.

restart.accepted: Klipper restart accepted. Wait for the machine to return; this does not confirm the configuration is valid.
restart.unknown: Restart outcome unknown. Check the machine before sending another request.

blocked: Saving and restarting are unavailable while printing, paused or disconnected.
limits: 1 MiB maximum, UTF-8. A .bak copy is created before each replacement.
saved: File saved and read back. Restart Klipper to apply changes.
imported: Loaded in the editor. Review and save to send this file to the machine.
saveDetail: Save “{path}” on “{machine}”? The previous file is backed up first. No automatic restart.
restartDetail: Restart Klipper on “{machine}” to reload its configuration? Save changes first. The server and MCUs are not restarted.
importHelp: Choose a .cfg path relative to config. Loading into the editor does not send the file; use Save afterwards.

errors.config-invalid: Invalid path or content: relative .cfg file, no traversal, 1 MiB maximum.
errors.config-size: Choose a UTF-8 .cfg file of 1 MiB maximum.
errors.config-encoding: Only UTF-8 text files are accepted.
errors.config-state: Machine busy or state cannot be verified. No changes sent.
errors.config-conflict: This file changed elsewhere. Your draft is retained; reload and compare before saving again.
errors.config-backup: Backup failed: the original file was not replaced.
errors.config-save-unknown: Save not confirmed. Check or download the file on the machine before trying again.
errors.command-busy: Another operation is in progress on this machine.
